h1: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Warsaw, 43 m²

blocks.text: Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Warsaw, 43 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed and completed a comprehensive project for a 43 m² apartment in Warsaw, Poland. The project combined interior design, technical documentation, custom-made furniture, turnkey renovation and final interior decoration.

The interior follows a contemporary style with minimalist elements. Clean lines, natural materials, a calm neutral colour palette and carefully planned lighting create a harmonious living environment. Particular attention was given to ergonomics, functionality and the efficient use of space in a compact apartment.

The project included space planning and interior design solutions, taking into account furniture placement, household equipment and integrated storage systems. Every element was selected according to the room dimensions, everyday functionality and the overall design concept.

Custom-made furniture was designed and manufactured specifically for the apartment. Built-in furniture and storage systems were developed to suit the architecture of the rooms, maximizing the available space while maintaining a consistent visual style throughout the interior.

Following the design stage, a comprehensive turnkey apartment renovation in Warsaw was completed in accordance with the developed technical documentation. The works included implementing the interior design solutions, installing the custom furniture and preparing the apartment for everyday use.
The final stage involved custom curtain production and interior decoration. Textiles and decorative elements complemented the overall concept, creating a cohesive and comfortable living space.

The completed project is presented through photographs of the finished apartment and custom-made furniture. This 43 m² apartment demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s comprehensive approach to small residential interiors — from the initial concept to a fully completed living environment.
